ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which ending shows that you are speaking to a boy? (1 mark)
   A. -ii
   B. -ka
   C. -ki
   D. -na

2. Which Arabic word means "I am well"? (1 mark)
   A. اسْمِي
   B. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   C. أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ
   D. مَرْحَبًا

3. What does the phrase al-hamdu lillaah express? (1 mark)
   A. Thanks to God
   B. A question about a name
   C. A goodbye
   D. A request to sit down

4. What does the Arabic sentence مَنْ هَذَا؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a brother and a sister.
   B. This is my father.
   C. Who is this? (a boy or man)
   D. This is my mother.

5. Which Arabic sentence means "This is my father." (1 mark)
   A. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ
   B. هَذِهِ أُمِّي
   C. أَبِي يَعْمَلُ
   D. هَذَا أَبِي

6. What does the Arabic word بِنْتٌ (bint) mean? (1 mark)
   A. daughter
   B. father's sister
   C. son
   D. mother's brother

7. What does the Arabic sentence الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The book is on the table.
   B. The pen is in the bag.
   C. The cat is under the bed.
   D. The lamp is above the table.

8. How is the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. taawila
   B. miftaah
   C. qitta
   D. khizaana

9. Which polite word means 'excuse me' when you want to speak? (1 mark)
   A. shukran
   B. naʿam
   C. ʿafwan
   D. laa

10. Which word means 'I drink'? (1 mark)
   A. aakulu
   B. uhibbu
   C. askunu
   D. ashrabu

11. In the game Simon Says, how do learners show they are listening? (1 mark)
   A. They cover their ears
   B. They act only on the correct instruction
   C. They act on every instruction
   D. They speak loudly

12. Which Arabic word means "stand up"? (1 mark)
   A. اِسْمَعْ
   B. أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ
   C. اِقْرَأْ
   D. قِفْ

13. What does the Arabic word جِسْمٌ (jism) mean? (1 mark)
   A. leg
   B. neck
   C. body
   D. back

14. Which Arabic sentence means "We look after the environment." (1 mark)
   A. الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ
   B. الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   C. نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ
   D. الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ

15. What is the name of the Arabic letter ز? (1 mark)
   A. dhaal
   B. alif
   C. miim
   D. zaay

16. What is the name of the Arabic letter ظ? (1 mark)
   A. haa
   B. baa
   C. faa
   D. DHaa

17. Which letters can make a vowel long? (1 mark)
   A. laam, miim and nuun
   B. baa, taa and thaa
   C. siin, shiin and Saad
   D. alif, waaw and yaa

18. How do you read the syllable تُ? (1 mark)
   A. bu
   B. nii
   C. thaa
   D. tu

19. How is the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. al-ithnayn
   B. as-sabt
   C. usbuuʿ
   D. amsi

20. Which sentence means 'I visit my grandmother on Friday'? (1 mark)
   A. alʿabu yawma s-sabt
   B. aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad
   C. azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa
   D. usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt

21. What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Above the table there is a balloon.
   B. This is a party.
   C. The friends are at the party.
   D. On the table there is a cake.

22. Which Arabic word means "book"? (1 mark)
   A. حَقِيبَةٌ
   B. سَاعَةٌ
   C. كِتَابٌ
   D. سِكِّينٌ

23. What does the Arabic sentence الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The table is small.
   B. The door is big.
   C. The window is clean.
   D. The chair is new.

24. How is the Arabic word حَقِيبَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. miftaah
   B. hammaam
   C. haqiiba
   D. bayt

25. Which two letters begin the names of the days of the week in Arabic script (the word 'the')? (1 mark)
   A. miim and nuun
   B. alif and laam
   C. siin and shiin
   D. baa and taa

26. Which Arabic word means "day"? (1 mark)
   A. الْأَحَدُ
   B. يَوْمٌ
   C. أَمْسِ
   D. السَّبْتُ

27. Which style is quick and simple and used for everyday handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Kufic
   B. Ruqʿah
   C. Diwani
   D. Thuluth

28. Which Arabic sentence means "The banana is delicious." (1 mark)
   A. أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ
   B. الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ
   C. آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ
   D. جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي

29. What should you check on a food chart before posting it? (1 mark)
   A. Only the colour
   B. Nothing
   C. Only the date
   D. The spelling, dots and marks

30. Which Arabic word means "clouds"? (1 mark)
   A. جَبَلٌ
   B. نَهْرٌ
   C. سَحَابٌ
   D. نَظِيفٌ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe two things you can do to pronounce the days of the week correctly. (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Write an Arabic question and its answer that you could use to find out who a woman in a photograph is. Use English letters. (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Describe how to make a food chart for the class wall. (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into English: al-jawwu mumtir (2 marks)

35. Translate into English: laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin (2 marks)

36. Translate into English: al-baytu kabiir (2 marks)

37. Translate into English: al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila (2 marks)

38. Give three examples of non-verbal cues you could use when reciting a poem about weather. (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Write five weather or environment words in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

40. Write four lines of a short conversation in which two friends greet each other and ask names. Use English letters for the Arabic. (4 marks) (4 marks)

41. Translate into English: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: anaa araa biʿaynii and atakallamu bi-famii. (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: anaa tilmiidha (2 marks)

44. Translate into English: ashrabu l-haliiba (2 marks)

45. Write three foods and two drinks in Arabic sounds with meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

46. List four characteristics of good handwriting. (4 marks) (4 marks)

47. Write a short speech of at least four sentences about your house in Arabic sounds (English letters). Give the meaning. (5 marks) (5 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — -ka
   The ending -ka is used when speaking to a boy or man, as in kayfa haaluka?

2. C — أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ
   أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) means I am well.

3. A — Thanks to God
   al-hamdu lillaah means 'thanks be to God' and is often said when answering 'How are you?'.

4. C — Who is this? (a boy or man)
   مَنْ هَذَا؟ (man haadhaa?) means: Who is this? (a boy or man)

5. D — هَذَا أَبِي
   هَذَا أَبِي (haadhaa abii) means: This is my father.

6. A — daughter
   بِنْتٌ (bint) means daughter.

7. B — The pen is in the bag.
   الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

8. D — khizaana
   خِزَانَةٌ is read khizaana and means cupboard.

9. C — ʿafwan
   ʿafwan is used to say 'excuse me' or 'pardon' before speaking.

10. D — ashrabu
   ashrabu means I drink. aakulu means I eat and uhibbu means I like.

11. B — They act only on the correct instruction
   The game trains careful listening to instructions.

12. D — قِفْ
   قِفْ (qif) means stand up.

13. C — body
   جِسْمٌ (jism) means body.

14. C — نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ
   نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ (nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a) means: We look after the environment.

15. D — zaay
   The letter ز is called zaay.

16. D — DHaa
   The letter ظ is called DHaa.

17. D — alif, waaw and yaa
   Alif, waaw and yaa lengthen a matching short vowel.

18. D — tu
   تُ is read tu.

19. C — usbuuʿ
   أُسْبُوعٌ is read usbuuʿ and means week.

20. C — azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa
   azuuru means I visit and jaddatii means my grandmother.

21. D — On the table there is a cake.
   عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka) means: On the table there is a cake.

22. C — كِتَابٌ
   كِتَابٌ (kitaab) means book.

23. A — The table is small.
   الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

24. C — haqiiba
   حَقِيبَةٌ is read haqiiba and means bag.

25. B — alif and laam
   al- is written with alif and laam.

26. B — يَوْمٌ
   يَوْمٌ (yawm) means day.

27. B — Ruqʿah
   Ruqʿah is a short, quick style used in notes and everyday writing.

28. B — الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ
   الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

29. D — The spelling, dots and marks
   Checking the words helps to avoid mistakes.

30. C — سَحَابٌ
   سَحَابٌ (sahaab) means clouds.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the teacher and repeat; say the days in a chain; practise the sounds th and kh slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid method.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: man haadhihi? haadhihi ummii. (Who is this? This is my mother.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer, 1 mark for correct use of haadhihi for a woman.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Draw local foods, write the Arabic name under each picture, colour it and post it on the wall for review.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for drawing, 1 mark for labels and 1 mark for posting or review.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not play with the knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: The house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: The book is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Lifting arms for the sun; wiggling fingers downwards for rain; smiling at the last line.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each cue that matches a word.

39. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), matar (rain), riih (wind), samaa' (sky).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: A: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. B: wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam. A: maa ismuka? B: ismii Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line: greeting, reply, question, answer.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cat is under the bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: I see with my eye. I speak with my mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each translation.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am a pupil (girl).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink milk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), samak (fish), mawz (bananas), maa' (water), haliib (milk).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Correct letter shapes; letters the same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; even spacing; clean page.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid characteristic, up to 4.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. ismii Amina. haadhaa baytii. fii baytii matbakh. shukran li-istimaaʿikum. (Peace be upon you. My name is Amina. This is my house. In my house there is a kitchen. Thank you for listening.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the topic sentence, 1 mark for a detail and 1 mark for the closing thanks.
